newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bof has no comment on talk of forex intervention.
newsitem.headline: Bof has no comment on talk of forex intervention.

text.p: The Bank of France declined comment on Wednesday on market rumours it was intervening in currency markets to support the franc.
"As a general policy, we do not comment on rumours," a spokesman for the Bank said.

Traders cited rumours that the central bank had been selling marks to bolster the franc when it fell to 3.3775 per mark or lower. But no trader contacted by Reuters confirmed that they had personally seen the Bank in the market.
"I can neither confirm nor deny those rumours of intervention," said the head of a trading desk at a large French bank.
At 1430 GMT, the franc was at 3.3804 per mark, off its low of 3.3812 per mark touched earlier, which was its lowest point since February 5, when it reached 3.3824 per mark.
